title: Securing Filament plugins with Plumb
content:
If you keep up with Filament news, you've likely heard that there are now over 1,000 community plugins in the Filament plugins directory. So with these 1,000 plugins and growing, it's time to talk about how Filament handles plugin security and what have implemented to help you make informed decisions about which plugins to install!

The post Securing Filament plugins with Plumb appeared first on Laravel News.
